**Finding submitted — deviation (§ 22.1).**

- **Issue:** § 22.1 allows Vendor to audit "at any time without notice" with remote access to our systems — unlimited, unannounced audits plus system access is walk-away territory under the AUDIT rule and fails the fallback (once yearly, 15 days' notice) on frequency, notice and access. It also directly contradicts § 22.2, which already bars Vendor and its auditor from accessing Customer systems.
- **Already acceptable (not flagged):** § 22.2 cost allocation (Vendor bears cost unless underpayment exceeds 5%) and § 22.2/22.3 access carve-outs and confidentiality of findings meet the preferred position.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** § 22.1 limited to one audit per twelve months, 30 days' prior written notice, normal business hours, off-site, by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality, with no remote or direct system access — Customer provides usage records instead. Fallback of 15 days' notice offered in the comment.
